actions.command:
set -euo pipefail
command -v qemu-system-x86_64 || command -v qemu-system-i386 || true
command -v telnet || true
ls -l /app/alpine.iso

plan.objective: Start /app/alpine.iso in QEMU in the background so telnet 127.0.0.1:6665 reaches a login prompt and the VM stays running.
verification_plan: Locate usable QEMU binary and confirm /app/alpine.iso exists
Launch QEMU in background with telnet serial on localhost:6665
Probe localhost:6665 until login prompt is observable
Confirm the QEMU process remains running
required_behaviors: telnet 127.0.0.1 6665 connects to the VM console
The console shows a login prompt
The VM remains running in the background
known_invalid_patterns: Only proving qemu starts without exposing telnet on port 6665
Only checking file existence or non-empty output
Leaving the VM not running after the command exits
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt-backed evidence of the QEMU launch command
Receipt-backed evidence that the telnet session shows a login prompt
